title: THE CRYOGENIC TRUTH ❄️
topic: The discovery of a hidden student-cloning facility in the school basement.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: LOOK AT THOSE FROST-COVERED GLASS TANKS [beat] THERE ARE ACTUAL STUDENTS TRAPPED INSIDE THIS FREEZER!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: My thermal scanner is glitching out because these pods are at absolute zero [beat] and look at the names on the digital labels!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: That’s Bruno’s older brother who disappeared three years ago [beat] and that girl who was supposed to move to another state!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: I told you the basement was off-limits for a reason [beat] some students are just too valuable to let go of so easily.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You’re literally freezing children to keep the school's reputation perfect [beat] you’re a total monster, Principal Huda!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: It's not about grades [beat] it's about preservation because the air outside these walls isn't what you think it is.

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Wait [beat] the labels don't say preservation they say cloning sequence and your status is already at ninety-nine percent!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: If the clone is almost finished [beat] then where is the original Principal Huda hidden in this frozen nightmare?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: You’re looking at her [beat] and very soon the school will have a brand new Nix who actually follows the rules.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Get your freezing hands off my friend [beat] I don't care about the rules anymore I just want my brother back!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Nix, look behind the central console [beat] there's a manual override but it needs a biological signature from a real human.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Principal Huda [beat] if you’re a clone then your fingerprint won’t work on that scanner and the whole system will melt!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Don't you dare touch that lever [beat] you have no idea what kind of ancient virus is sleeping inside those tanks!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I’m pulling it anyway [beat] because anything is better than being your frozen trophy for the next fifty years!
